description: Create a new task in a project. title and project_id are required. Use boolean is_done/is_milestone (same field names as the GET response); a milestone task must have a due_date. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

due_date.description: Task due date (YYYY-MM-DD, null to clear)

is_milestone.description: Mark as milestone (true/false); a milestone task must have a due_date

parent_task_id.description: ID of the parent task (null for root-level)

priority.description: Task priority (integer >= 0, or null to unset)

project_id.description: ID of the project this task belongs to (required)

start_date.description: Task start date (YYYY-MM-DD, null to clear)

name: pipedrive_create_task
